name: Student
description: A learner who registers, logs in, searches for lectures, views lecture details, pays for and enrolls in lectures, and watches video content.

name: Instructor
description: A content creator who registers, logs in, uploads lecture videos, and views enrollment and revenue statistics for their own lectures.

name: Administrator
description: A system manager who can remove inappropriate lectures from public view and perform other governance tasks.

name: Payment Provider
description: An external third‑party service that processes payment card information and completes the financial transaction for lecture purchases.
